Name: Ethnicity ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the ethnicity. Only available to reference existing records.

Name: Ethnicity
Description: The person's ethnicity.

Name: Legislation Code
Description: The ethnicity legislation code.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person to whom this ethnicity record relates.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person to whom this ethnicity record relates.

Name: Declarer ID
Description: A unique reference to the person who identified the person's ethnicity details.

Name: Declarer Person Number
Description: The person number of the person who identified the person's ethnicity details.

Name: Primary Ethnicity
Description: Indicates whether this is the primary ethnicity record for the person in this legislation.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
